Name: Self Service
Author: JarvieK
Description:
[size=3]Allows to shop at these shops when no one attends the counter:

[list]
[*]Pierre's
[*]Animal shop
[*]Carpenter's shop
[*]Fish shop
[/list][/size]


[size=5]Installation[/size]

[size=3]get SMAPI from http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375/[/size]

[size=3]unpack the zip file and move all files to the game directory[/size]

[size=3]start game with SMAPI

[/size]

Feel free to report bugs, feature requests, etc. to here:

[/size]
